mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5%, it signals imminent monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and decreases in UNRATE signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive Fed tightening, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction (FEDFUNDS up and UNRATE down) does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, declining retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, RSAFS declines do not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong consumer confidence and economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation and forces premature Fed rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate demand-supply mismatch where consumer demand outstrips manufacturing capacity, reducing profit visibility and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The interaction (HOUST up and INDPRO down) does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery phases, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In the post-pandemic recovery regime, INDPRO declines do not lead to negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).
